description: This file defines a PHP controller class 'VacancyListRSSController' responsible for generating an RSS feed of active job vacancies. It handles the HTTP response, constructs an XML RSS feed with vacancy details, and references external services and routing components specific to the recruitment module of the OrangeHRM system.

classes.name: VacancyListRSSController
classes.description: A controller class responsible for generating an RSS feed of active job vacancies. Implements the 'PublicControllerInterface' and extends 'AbstractController'. Uses various traits to encapsulate services for vacancy retrieval, configuration, date-time handling, and internationalization.

methods.name: handle
methods.description: Handles the HTTP request to generate and return the RSS feed response.

methods.name: generateRSSFeed
methods.description: Constructs the RSS feed XML document with vacancy data, including titles, descriptions, links, and publication dates.

methods.name: getPublishedVacancies
methods.description: Retrieves the list of published vacancy entities from the vacancy service.
